title: Return, v
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: Friday. The Sunday ruled — the first new landscape since the reruns. The pup on the Arches. Pawprints. Wood leaves them and paints around them. The strip's first Sunday back will have three-toed prints in the sky.

panels.composition: The garage. A sheet of Arches on the board, tiers ruled. WOOD turning to the sill. BARNABY II climbing the table. Wet paws.

characters.pose: climbing onto the table, wet paws

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a small three-legged puppy with wet paws climbing onto a drafting table where a ruled watercolor sheet lies, a man turned toward the windowsill

panels.composition: The sheet. Three-toed prints across the top tier. Wet. Perfect.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, close-up of a blank ruled watercolor sheet with a trail of small three-toed wet pawprints across its top tier
image.notes: Three-toed prints: the pup's front paws are two; the hind is one; draw the trail uneven.

panels.composition: Wood turning back. Looking at the prints. The pup looking at him: nothing to declare.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a man looking at pawprints on his blank sheet while a small puppy looks back with an innocent expression, no words

panels.composition: Wood dipping the brush. Painting the sky around the prints. Leaving them. The first Sunday back will have him in it that way.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a man laying a watercolor wash onto a sheet while carefully painting around a trail of small pawprints in the sky area, no words
image.notes: Sunday Sept 27, 2015 (not in the batch): the bay with three-toed prints in the sky.

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: Pawprints on the Arches. Painted around. The pup in the first Sunday back.
